ticks.note: A is entered; its transition is delayed, so nothing fires: x = 0.

A's delayed transition fires (x = 1) and enters B in this same tick. B's immediate transition fires straight away (x = 11) and enters C. C's immediate transition is checked too, but J is false, so the reaction stops in C.
C was entered in the previous tick; its immediate transition is checked again in every later tick and now J holds: x = 111, state D.
D has no transitions: x stays 111.
